z-m-39-01.title: Ingaba amaxabiso ahlukeneyo anokuba nesixa esifanayo?
z-m-39-01.topic: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi nemisebenzi one-to-one: imeko yesixa samaxabiso nobukhulu be-codomain
z-m-39-01.goal: Sebenzisa umzekelo ochasayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba intsingiselo yomsebenzi one-to-one (iilungu ezahlukeneyo zihambelana namaxabiso ahlukeneyo) ayithi nto ngezixa zamaxabiso, uze uchaze ukuba ukuba umsebenzi onemeko efanayo ukhona na kuxhomekeke kwi-codomain.
z-m-39-01.material: Cinga ngomsebenzi f ukusuka kwidomeyini X={1, 2, 3, 4} ukuya kwi-codomain Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7} njengetheyibhile yamaxabiso. Itheyibhile idwelisa f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) kuphela (akukho ntetho). Imeko (가): f ngumsebenzi one-to-one, oko kukuthi iilungu ezahlukeneyo ze-X zihambelana namaxabiso ahlukeneyo. Imeko (나): f(1)+f(4)=f(2)+f(3). UMina wathi, “Ukuba one-to-one, onke amaxabiso amane ayahluka. Ngoko izixa zezibini ezimbini azinakulingana njengakwi-(나).”
z-m-39-01.thinking.1: Ukwakha imizekelo eyahlukileyo (imizekelo echasayo) enelisa iimeko
z-m-39-01.thinking.2: Ukugweba ngokweemeko ukuba umsebenzi onjalo ukhona xa i-codomain itshintsha
z-m-39-01.prereq.0: Intsingiselo yomsebenzi, idomeyini, i-codomain, nobubanzi, nentsingiselo yomsebenzi one-to-one (inxalenye yokuqala yecandelo lemisebenzi yeMathematika Eqhelekileyo yesikolo samabanga aphezulu)
z-m-39-01.prereq.2: (Ingcinga yolandelelwano lwesikolo: I-H2 yalo msebenzi yilebhile yobunzima ebelwe kwimveliso kuphela, kwaye sicinga ukuba izinto ezifunekayo ngasentla sele zifundiwe.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.prompt: Khetha isigwebo sakho sokuqala sengxelo kaMina. (Akufuneki ubale okwangoku.)
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ngo-f(1), f(2), f(3), f(4) njengezithuba ezine, uzalise amanani amane ahlukeneyo.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ngamanani owazalisileyo, bhala f(1)+f(4) kunye ne-f(2)+f(3) ngokwahlukileyo uthelekise ukuba ayalingana na.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.a: Kulungile. Ukuba onke amaxabiso amane ayahluka, izixa zezibini ezimbini ziyahluka nazo
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.a: Uphatha “amaxabiso ayahluka” kunye “nezixa ziyahluka” njengengxelo enye. Khetha izibini ezimbini zamanani ahlukeneyo wena uthelekise izixa.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.b: Kulungile. Umsebenzi one-to-one uba mkhulu njengoko x iba nkulu, ngoko izixa azinakulingana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.b: Uphatha umsebenzi one-to-one nomsebenzi onyukayo njengento enye. Cinga ukuba ikhona na imisebenzi one-to-one apho amaxabiso ehla.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.c: Kuphosakele. Nokuba onke amaxabiso ayahluka, izixa zezibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zinokulingana
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.c: Ufunde ibango njenge-“ihlala” wathandabuza ukuba ikho na imizekelo. Ngoku lixesha lokuvavanya ukuba umzekelo onjalo unokwakhiwa ngokwenene.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.o.d: Asikwazi ukugweba. Kungenxa yokuba intetho ye-f ayinikwanga
z-m-39-01.s.s1.r.d: Ucinga umsebenzi njengentetho kuphela. Apha, itheyibhile yamaxabiso amane yodwa yanele ukuvavanya iimeko.
z-m-39-01.s.s1.explain: Imeko yokuba ngumsebenzi one-to-one ithi kuphela amaxabiso amane ayahluka. Ukuba izixa zezibini ezimbini zinokulingana nokuba amaxabiso amane ayahluka kufuneka kuhlolwe ngokufumana umzekelo ngokwenene. Masiyivavanye kwinyathelo elilandelayo.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.prompt: Usebenzisa itheyibhile yamaxabiso, yakha imisebenzi emi-2 f enelisa zombini iimeko (가) kunye no-(나) kwaye ene-f(1) enkulu kune-f(2). Imisebenzi ezimbini kufuneka isebenzise iiseti zamaxabiso ezahlukeneyo. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), d=f(4); onke amanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7)
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kuqala fumana iqela lamanani amane ahlukeneyo apho f(1)+f(4) no-f(2)+f(3) zilingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.1: Beka amanani amane owafumeneyo ukuze f(1) ibe nkulu kune-f(2), uhlole kwakhona ukuba izixa ezimbini zisalingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.hint.2: Fumana elinye iqela amanani aso ahlukile kwawo asetyenziswe kumsebenzi wokuqala.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Onke amaxabiso amane aziilungu ze-codomain Y (amanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7).
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Onke amaxabiso kufuneka abe ngamanani apheleleyo asuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-7.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.ok.c2: Onke amaxabiso amane ayahluka, ngoko ngumsebenzi one-to-one.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Ixabiso elifanayo lisetyenzisiwe kabini. Asingomsebenzi one-to-one.
z-m-39-01.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, (3, 1, 6, 4) ine-3+4=7=1+6 kwaye onke amaxabiso amane ayahluka. Ngoko ibango likaMina alibambi. Kwakhona, kuba kukho umzekelo ene-f(1)>f(2), umsebenzi one-to-one awuhambeli kumaxabiso amakhulu kuphela. ((1, 2, 3, 4) yanelisa imeko yesixa kodwa iphula f(1)>f(2), ngoko ayamkelwa kweli nyathelo.)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.prompt: Ulwazi olutsha: idomeyini ihlala X={1, 2, 3, 4} kwaye iimeko (가) kunye no-(나) zihlala zinjalo, kodwa i-codomain Y itshintshiwe njengoko kungezantsi. Khetha zonke ii-codomain apho umsebenzi f unelisa iimeko unokwenziwa. (Akukho meko f(1)>f(2).)
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.0: Kwi-codomain nganye, khetha amanani amane ahlukeneyo, uwahlule abe zizibini ezimbini, ubhale izixa zezibini ezimbini ecaleni kwelinye.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.hint.1: Ukuba i-codomain inamalungu angaphantsi kwama-4, kuqala bala ukuhlola ukuba umsebenzi one-to-one unokwenziwa kwaphela.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.a: Kubonakala ucinge ukuba ukuba namalungu angama-5 kwanele. Khetha amane kuwo, uwahlule abe zizibini ezimbini, ubhale wena ukuba likho na ityala apho izixa zilingana.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.b: Ujonge hayi nje inani lamalungu kodwa nenyaniso yokuba amanani ahleliwe ngokulinganayo. Hlola ukuba ufumene izibini ezimbini ezinezixa ezilinganayo.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.c: Ukuba ujonga imeko yesixa kuqala, kulula ukuphosa ukuba amalungu awaneli. Kuqala bala ukuba zingaphi izixa ezifunekayo ukuba ngumsebenzi one-to-one.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.r.d: Uhlolile ukuba i-codomain ebukhulu obufanayo nedomeyini inazo izibini ezimbini ezinezixa ezilinganayo nayo. Uqwalasele imeko apho onke amanani amane asetyenziswa.
z-m-39-01.s.s3.explain: {1,2,3} inamalungu ama-3 kuphela, ngoko amalungu amane e-X awanakuba namaxabiso ahlukeneyo, kwaye akukho msebenzi one-to-one kwaphela. {1,2,3,4} ine-1+4=2+3, kwaye {2,5,8,11,14} inazo izibini ezimbini ezinezixa ezilinganayo ezinje nge-2+14=5+11. {1,2,4,8,16} inamalungu ama-5, kodwa akukho tyala apho izixa zezibini ezimbini ezahlukeneyo zilingana. Akukhona ukuba ukuba namalungu amaninzi kwanele; ngawaphi amanani yinto ebalulekileyo.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.prompt: Chazela uMina. Bhala (1) apho ibango lokuqala liphosakala khona, ngomzekelo wamanani, no-(2) ukuba umsebenzi onemeko efanayo awuhlali ukhona, usebenzisa i-codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.0: Thatha enye yeetheyibhile owazenzileyo kwinyathelo 2 njengoko injalo, ubhale amaxabiso amane nezixa ezimbini.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.hint.1: Khetha i-codomain enye ongakhethanga kwinyathelo 3, ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye ukuba kutheni umsebenzi ungenakwenziwa ngaloo codomain.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Kumzekelo wakho wamanani, ngaba kucacile ukuba onke amaxabiso amane ayahluka kwaye izixa zezibini ezimbini ziyalingana?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ngaba uhlukanise oko "one-to-one" kusixelela kona noko kungasixeleli?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.selfAssess.2: Ngaba unike imizekelo (imeko enamalungu ambalwa kakhulu, okanye imeko engenazibini ezinezixa ezilinganayo) ebonisa ukuba ngokuxhomekeke kwi-codomain umsebenzi usenokubakho okanye ungabikho?
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.0: Amaxabiso amane ahlukeneyo angaba nezixa ezilinganayo. Umzekelo, ukuba f(1)=3, f(2)=1, f(3)=6, f(4)=4, ngoko onke amaxabiso ayahluka kwaye 3+4=1+6=7. Kodwa ukuba i-codomain yiseti enjenge-{1, 2, 4, 8, 16}, engenazibini ezimbini ezinezixa ezilinganayo, umsebenzi onjalo awunakwenziwa.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.model.1: Umsebenzi one-to-one uthetha kuphela ukuba amaxabiso awagqubani; awuthethi ukuba izixa ziyahluka. Ukuba f(1)=2, f(2)=1, f(3)=4, f(4)=3, ngoko 2+3=1+4=5, ngoko izixa ziyalingana. Kodwa ukuba i-codomain inamalungu ama-3 kuphela, akukho nomsebenzi one-to-one, ngoko ngokuxhomekeke kwiseti ethini i-codomain, umsebenzi usenokubakho okanye ungabikho.
z-m-39-01.s.s4.modelNote.1: Ayizange ikhankanye ukuba amaxabiso ayanyuka, kodwa inalo umzekelo ochasayo nemeko ye-codomain.
